summary.overview: In the recent catch-up meeting between Jack and Ahmed, they discussed several important topics, starting with Jack’s stressful situation regarding his move to a new flat in North London, which is pending due to unresolved references. Ahmed shared that their LinkedIn outreach for TSG has shown promising results, although they received a rejection from PNG. They also outlined follow-up actions, with Ahmed planning to contact Oliver about NDA matters, while Jack will review a one-pager from Ahmed. The conversation shifted to strategic outreach, highlighting the need to target private equity firms like KKR, particularly those engaged in retail acquisitions. Jack stressed the focus on retail and data providers, aiming to secure at least one Letter of Intent (LOI) as a significant milestone. Specific action items were assigned, including Jack’s review of documents and outreach to private equity firms, along with Ahmed’s task to compile a list of top European retailers for targeted LinkedIn engagement.
